description:
Computes topological execution waves over a strategic-tier container's sub-strategic children, grouping them by dependency depth so the containers can be driven in order.

## Background

`jit-execution-lead` already layers an epic's issue-level children into waves by hand-computing dependency depth from `jit graph deps <epic-id>` (its Wave Planning section: Wave 1 holds children with no sibling dependencies, Wave N holds children whose dependencies all sit in waves 1..N-1). No topological/wave primitive exists in jit itself for this — the layering is computed in skill prose, not the CLI. The one-tier-up analogue needed here layers sub-strategic containers (for example epics) instead of individual issues, reading `jit graph deps <container-id>` against the strategic-tier parent.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Given a strategic-tier container's id, grouping its direct sub-strategic children (read via `jit graph deps <container-id>`) by dependency depth produces an ordered list of waves — Wave 1 holds children with no sibling dependencies, Wave N holds children whose sibling dependencies all sit in waves 1..N-1 — covering every sub-strategic child exactly once.
- [hard] REQ-02: The wave-computation logic, including a worked example over a small sample container graph, is documented as skill prose (a SKILL.md section or a `references/` file) in the cc-sdd/superpowers register — terse imperative voice, explicit inputs and outputs, no filler — following the exemplars at `../jit-research/cc-sdd/tools/cc-sdd/templates/agents/claude-code-skills/skills/kiro-spec-design/SKILL.md`, `../jit-research/superpowers/skills/writing-plans/SKILL.md`, and `../jit-research/superpowers/skills/executing-plans/SKILL.md`.

## Notes

Produces an ordered wave list (waves of container ids) as its output; does not itself dispatch or review any container.
title: Layer sub-strategic containers into dependency-ordered waves
